articles.title: From seed to fruit: How to grow papaya successfully on your balcony
articles.description: A papaya tree laden with golden fruit on your balcony sounds like a dream, but it is closer to reality than most people think. Papaya is one of the fastest-growing fruit plants, and a dwarf variety in a large pot can give you homegrown fruit within a year, as long as it gets plenty of sun, warmth and room for its roots. Here is a simple five-step guide to growing papaya on a balcony, from the first seed to the first harvest.

It is also expected to substantially contribute to box office revenues during the Diwali season.

articles.title: Salman Khan's house firing: Shooter denied bail for brother's wedding

The special court denied his request for release on December 1 and 2, 2026. However, it allowed him to attend via video conference under prison security protocols. Gupta must provide an email ID for the virtual link to the ceremony.

articles.title: Kai Cenat accidentally exposes $23,232 TikTok earnings during livestream with Looze Cannon

The 30-minute session reportedly generated another $7,000 to $7,300 through virtual gifts. Their TikTok LIVE battle saw Cenat receive over 200,000 gifts, while Cannon collected more than 1.4 million. The unexpected reveal sparked conversations about livestream earnings and the growing business of online entertainment.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV meets Bob Dylan at the Vatican, exchanges gifts. What did they give each other?
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV met music legend Bob Dylan at the Vatican, where they exchanged gifts during a brief meeting. The Pope presented the 85-year-old singer with a rosary, while Dylan gifted him his autobiography, Chronicles: Volume One. According to Vatican News, their interaction included greetings and lighthearted exchanges.

articles.title: Released WWE star admits being "little envious" of his family members still a part of the company

While he expressed excitement about his father's return to WWE, he lamented his own absence from the roster. Tonga Loa also hinted at a possible release amidst recent talent cuts, leaving fans speculating about his wrestling future after concluding his tenure this year.

articles.title: In 2024, Eva Longoria received $50 million from Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez for philanthropy; two years later, she says you don't have to be a billionaire to make a difference

Two years later, the actor and philanthropist is highlighting how making a difference does not require immense wealth. She says mentoring, supporting small businesses and sharing knowledge can also create meaningful change in communities.

articles.title: Arantxa Sánchez Vicario looks back on dethroning Steffi Graf as world No. 1 and calls it a career-defining luxury
articles.description: Arantxa Sánchez Vicario has revisited her legendary rivalry with Steffi Graf, describing dethroning the German as world No. 1 as a luxury. The four-time Grand Slam champion recalled their seven major finals, including her stunning 1989 French Open victory. She also remembered defeating Graf twice in Hamburg in 1993 and 1994, despite playing in front of the German's home crowd.

articles.title: Bengaluru techie who threatened Ayushmann, Tusshar in Bishnoi gang's name arrested

This unsettling incident followed a frightening shooting attack on Tiger Shroff, which the gang readily acknowledged, inciting widespread fear within the film industry.

articles.title: Travis Kelce donated $1 million as Pennsylvania food bank funding drops from $4.24 million to $2.69 million

Swift's connection to the Reading community makes the gesture especially meaningful, while the donation could help more local families access essential food assistance.

articles.title: Trump’s 22-Minute Pool Monologue Gets a Brutal ‘Notting Hill’ Comparison From CNN’s Kasie Hunt
articles.description: CNN anchor Kasie Hunt took aim at Donald Trump’s final midterm message after the president spent the opening 22 minutes of his election-eve speech discussing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool renovation. Hunt joked that Trump was “a man” standing by a pool, asking Americans to love it—a line echoing the romantic comedy Notting Hill. Trump later turned to the midterms, after detailing the pool’s repairs and praising the makeover. The address took place in Washington on November 2, 2026.
